title: Hamburger
description: Hamburger is a timeless continental classic featuring a juicy, perfectly seasoned beef patty served on a toasted brioche bun with melted cheese, fresh vegetables, and a rich herb aioli. This professional chef's recipe delivers restaurant-quality flavor, texture, and presentation.

ingredients.title: For the Patties
items: 600 g high-quality beef chuck (20% fat, freshly ground)
200 g dry-aged beef ribeye trim (optional, for depth of flavor)
Sea salt & freshly cracked black pepper

ingredients.title: Garnishes
items: 4 slices of aged cheddar or Gruyère
Caramelized onions (optional: slow-cooked in butter and balsamic)

instruction.title: 1. Prepare the Patties
steps: Mix ground beef gently with Dijon, Worcestershire, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Form into 4 patties, slightly wider than the buns. Press a small dimple in the center (prevents puffing).
Chill in the fridge for 20 minutes to firm up.

instruction.title: 2. Cook the Patties
steps: Heat a cast-iron skillet or grill pan until smoking hot.
Cook patties 3–4 minutes per side for medium-rare, adding cheese in the final minute so it melts perfectly.
Rest the patties for 2–3 minutes before assembling.

instruction.title: 3. Toast the Buns
steps: Lightly butter brioche buns and toast cut side down until golden.

instruction.title: 4. Make the Sauce
steps: Combine all sauce ingredients. Adjust acidity with extra lemon juice if desired.

instruction.title: 5. Assemble
steps: Spread herb aioli on both bun halves.
Layer lettuce → patty with cheese → caramelized onions → tomato slice → pickles.
Cap with the top bun and gently press.

servingSuggestions.title: Serving Suggestions
items: Serve with truffle-parmesan fries or a small mesclun salad with vinaigrette.

chefTips: For added refinement, brush patties with a touch of beef jus or red wine glaze before assembling.
Always rest patties before serving—this is what keeps them juicy in fine-dining kitchens.
